biography.plain_text: Lucien S. Riley, known as Lute Riley, is an American businessman who founded Lute Riley Honda in Texas. His Richardson business became one of the country's largest Honda dealerships before Sonic Automotive acquired it in 1999. The sale brought a substantial independent franchise into a rapidly expanding national dealership group.

long_biography.plain_text:
Car dealer Lucien Riley's business extended beyond the showroom. Alongside new and used vehicles, his company sold replacement parts, maintained customers' cars and operated a separate body shop in Dallas. It also arranged financing and insurance through outside institutions, earning commissions on those transactions. General manager Rene Isip and his team developed the dealership's vehicle leasing and Internet marketing.

Riley's interests included the property beneath the operating business. He, R. Leona Riley and their family partnership owned real estate included in a separate agreement with the buyer. The dealership purchase was conditional on completion of the separate property transaction.
